scope: Complete finite reduced-Mumford polynomial-pair model only. No formal geometric Picard/Jacobian identification, ambient Cantor group law, cyclic-subgroup counterexample, multi-field census, asymptotic failure or complexity result. Qualified Gaudry fixed-genus q-to-infinity limit is not refuted. Identity included.
statement: For f=X^5-X over F3, the complete space of actual polynomial pairs with u monic of degree at most2, degree(v)<degree(u), and u dividing v^2-f has cardinality8, with7completely split u. The curve polynomial is monic, degree5 and separable. An explicit complete coefficient classification and bijection establish the counts. The finite fraction is7/8 and its error from1/2 is3/8, refuting an exact finite-half reading.
